notes: ConditionalsIMD is a fixed-supply ERC-20 with 18 decimals. Its argument-free constructor mints all 1,000,000,000 tokens once to msg.sender, the launch factory. Transfers charge no token fee. There are no administrative powers or post-deployment minting functions. No application contracts or initialization calls are required. pool.initialPrice records provenance only; the deployer derives the opening price from economics.initialMarketCapWei and totalSupply.
